Para comprobarlo, usa `ping miapp.test`: su primera línea dice a qué IP va. Páralo con <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>C</kbd>.

Y si programas, en DevTools:

- **_DNS Lookup_ en la pestaña _Timing_** es esta consulta. En la primera petición a un dominio verás unos milisegundos; en las siguientes, 0 o ni aparece, porque la respuesta está en caché o la conexión se reutiliza.
edits.why: `ping` no se explicaba y no termina solo; DevTools queda al final, como extra para quien programa.

edits.old: because a browser can't send UDP, but it can send HTTPS requests.
edits.new: because a web page can't send UDP, but it can send HTTPS requests.
edits.why: Precisión: el navegador sí usa UDP (HTTP/3, lección 5); lo que no puede es una página web.

edits.old: - **_DNS Lookup_ in the DevTools _Timing_ tab** is this query. On the first request to a domain you'll see a few milliseconds; on the following ones, 0, or it doesn't show up at all, because the answer is cached or the connection is reused.
edits.new: - **The “DNS” field in your Wi-Fi settings** (on your phone or computer) is your resolver's address. It's often your router, which forwards queries to your internet provider's resolver.
edits.why: Ejemplo cotidiano (el wifi) en lugar de DevTools, que baja al final de la sección como opcional.

edits.old: When you connect a domain to Vercel, Netlify or GitHub Pages,
edits.new: When you connect a domain to a service like Wix, Vercel, Netlify or GitHub Pages,
edits.why: Añade un servicio que usa gente que no programa (Wix) junto a los de desarrolladores.

edits.new:
To test it, use `ping myapp.test`: its first line tells you which IP it's going to. Stop it with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>C</kbd>.

And if you code, in DevTools:

- **_DNS Lookup_ in the _Timing_ tab** is this query. On the first request to a domain you'll see a few milliseconds; on the following ones, 0, or it doesn't show up at all, because the answer is cached or the connection is reused.
edits.why: `ping` no se explicaba y no termina solo; DevTools queda al final, como extra para quien programa.
